facts.fact: After the assize Rema sent Chathu south to Kodiyur in a closed cart with her roll, to be held for the high court; he is now in the queen's cells under the palace rock.
facts.why: needed because the beat places Chathu in the queen's cells; earlier canon had him held at Kettamala.

facts.fact: Neela has never seen the palace at Kodiyur except as a shape from the quay; she knows only the fish-market lanes and the Chirayil north warehouse.
facts.why: needed to show the hole in her plan: nobody in the party knows the sea stair.

facts.fact: The Company's vote was 20 to hold the narrows with none going south, 22 for a party going south, with Thulasi abstaining; the resin was split even by hands, 37 to 6, with the six carrying their pinches in a leaf.
facts.why: needed to record the split decision and resin split the outline calls for.

facts.fact: The six for Kodiyur are Neela, Pavi, Thilak, Madhavi, Kuttu and Meenu.
facts.why: outline names the party; listed so later chapters keep it.
